About The McGennis Family

In the Service of God

Building a legacy of entrepreneurship, faith, and community service in Jefferson City, Missouri

Our Story

The McGennis family is on a mission of building businesses and serving communities in Jefferson City, Missouri through innovation, service, and unwavering commitment to our community. Led by Caleb Michael McGennis and Stephanie Kay McGennis, we're building businesses, serving in ministry, and raising the next generation of leaders.

Caleb, also known online as dr4g0nbyt3, brings entrepreneurial vision and technical expertise to our family's ventures. With multiple successful businesses including BXP, The Honey Homestead, What's the Process for, Toxic Tournaments, Nostalgia Nuke, and LoHP (League of Honorable Players), our family demonstrates that diverse interests and passions can come together to create meaningful impact.

Our commitment extends beyond business. Caleb serves actively with Sports Crusaders ministry, bringing together faith and athletics to build community. His extensive ministry experience includes 5 years with the Missouri Baptist Convention as A/V and computer specialist and 1 year at Concord Baptist Church as media director.

Together with our two wonderful sons, Leonardo Bryton and Raphael Corwyn, we're building a family legacy rooted in faith, hard work, and service to Jefferson City and Central Missouri.

Our Core Values

Entrepreneurship

We believe in creating value through innovation and hard work. Our diverse business ventures demonstrate our commitment to building sustainable enterprises that serve our community.

Faith & Ministry

Our faith guides everything we do. Through active ministry work with Sports Crusaders and local churches, we strive to make a positive spiritual impact in Jefferson City.

Community Service

Jefferson City is our home, and we're committed to making it better. Through business, ministry, and volunteer work, we serve our neighbors and strengthen our community.

Family First

Family is the foundation of everything we do. We're raising Leonardo and Raphael with strong values, teaching them the importance of faith, hard work, and service.

Innovation

From technology solutions to retro gaming, we embrace innovation across all our ventures. We're not afraid to try new things and push boundaries in Jefferson City's business landscape.

Excellence

We strive for excellence in everything we do, from our businesses to our ministry work. Our goal is to set the standard for quality and integrity in Jefferson City.

Our Impact in Jefferson City

6+ Businesses

Operating diverse ventures across technology, agriculture, gaming, and project management sectors in Jefferson City and beyond.

6 Years Ministry

Combined years of dedicated service with Missouri Baptist Convention, Concord Baptist Church, and ongoing work with Sports Crusaders.

1 Family Vision

United in our mission to make Jefferson City proud and build a lasting legacy for Leonardo and Raphael.

100% Committed

Fully dedicated to Jefferson City, Missouri and making our community a better place through faith, business, and service.
